jobs.description:
Monjasa is a global partner in the oil and shipping industries. Its core business includes oil trading and supply, terminal operations, agency, and ship-owning activities. Founded in Denmark in 2002, Monjasa today employs approximately 750 people, serves customers in more than 800 ports and operates a fleet of 30 vessels. The group also provides offshore hotels and project services through CBED Floating Hotels.

Global financial controlling and reporting

As Group Controller, you will join the group controlling team and work with the preparation and consolidation of monthly internal financial statements, budgets, and year-end external financial statements. You will validate financial figures across group companies and work closely with finance teams in Denmark and Finance Managers worldwide.

Specific work tasks:

• Controlling and reviewing of a broad variety of Danish entities within various industries.

• Participating in preparation of internal reporting to Management and the Board of Directors.

• Participating in the preparation of the group annual report and the year-end process for a broad variety of Danish entities.

• Further develop and maintain group-related controlling and review processes, ensuring lean and effective procedures.

• Building and maintaining strong relations with internal stakeholders.

• Participating in budget and estimate processes.

• Act as sparring partner for the group accounting team.

• Analysing group financial performance and development.

• Preparing audit material.

• Assisting with the quality assurance of consolidated figures.

• Assisting group Tax with corporate income tax returns.

Based in Fredericia, you will report to the Group Finance Director and join a group finance team of 10 employees. The role includes 5-10 travel days a year and offers flexibility regarding working from home.

Ambitious and curious financial profile with strong interpersonal skills

We expect you to hold a cand.merc.aud or HD-R and have at least three years of experience as an auditor working with international clients. Experience from a similar role in an international organisation is an advantage. You know Danish accounting requirements and IFRS, have strong skills in Excel, ERP, consolidation and BI tools, and you communicate fluently in Danish and English.

We are looking for a Group Controller who is independent and proactive. You are committed to meeting deadlines and delivering high-quality work on time. Curious and unafraid to challenge the status quo, you are ambitious and committed to achieving high-quality results. You possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills and communicate effectively with individuals at all levels and across cultures.

Join Monjasa – a global company with a strong team spirit

Monjasa offers a fulfilling career in a modern global organisation with strong learning opportunities. The values Respect, Ambition, Curiosity and Smile & Joy, together with the purpose “Monjasa means personal business”, guide how colleagues work together. Despite its global growth, Monjasa has maintained a flexible culture and strong relationships across locations.

Please note that all enquiries will be handled with confidentiality and that we will reply to the email address from which you send your CV.

The opportunity

Founded in 2016, Mover is a Danish logistics technology company on a mission to change logistics for good, reducing waste and making people’s lives better.

Are you passionate about building great software products? Do you obsess over your customers? Are you interested in working with the latest state-of-the-art AI-driven development practices in order to invent and simplify? A once-in-a-company opportunity to lead engineering early as the company scales! 🚀

At proprty.ai, we’re building domain-specific AI for data-driven building maintenance and portfolio planning. Our predictive models estimate the condition and remaining lifespan of building components, and we turn that into prioritised maintenance plans across entire portfolios. Our AI agent, Tily, can take action on users' behalf and help them run strategic analysis of their building portfolio, helping large property owners and managers maintain their buildings efficiently, cost-effectively and sustainably.

The product went live in 2024 and is already solving real problems for real people, with customers across Denmark, Norway, and Germany. There is still so much we can do to make it even better, and you could help shape the future of building maintenance – and how engineering is run at proprty.ai.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a player-coach who loves leading engineers and still wants to write code. You might coach a developer through a tricky problem in the morning and ship a feature yourself in the afternoon.

You've led an engineering team before at a startup or scale-up where the foundations were still being laid, and you know that in a small team, leadership means leading by doing. You care about shipping fast and shipping well.

We're an AI-first company (it's in our name). You've built AI agents and AI features into real products, and you're excited to push that further, both in what we build for customers and in how the team works.

About The Team

We're a small but mighty crew of four engineers who love solving tricky problems together, working on-site in our office near Rådhuspladsen. We work closely with our data science team to bring machine learning models trained on millions of m² of building data into the product. We talk a lot (in a good way), pair up when things get tough, and keep the vibe light with plenty of jokes and good energy.

About The Role

• Lead, coach, and grow the team as a player-coach, while still writing code on core features

• Own how we build and ship. Our goal is to release several times a week without letting quality, reliability, or security slip

• Guide the platform's technical direction, including architecture and code quality

• Design and build AI agents and AI features into the product, and work with Data Science to take models from prototype to production

• Help turn input from customers, Sales and Customer Success into features the team can build

• Improve the team's AI tools and workflows (we use Cursor and Perplexity) so everyone can build faste

About you

• You've led an engineering team before at a startup or scale-up, including coaching and hiring developers

• You have strong hands-on full-stack experience with React, TypeScript and SQL

• You've built (or have strong interest in) AI agents and AI features in production

• You take full ownership from design to implementation, and you lead by doing

• You live in the Copenhagen area (we're in the office 4 days a week)

• Bonus points if you've worked with Postgres and Next.js, or in real estate or proptech

Even if you don't tick every box, we'd still love to hear from you if you're an experienced engineering leader who learns fast and loves building things!

TL;DR

Want to get in early with a great team? Love leading engineers and still writing code? Apply now to lead our dev team and make building maintenance smarter and more sustainable with AI.

jobs.occupation: Engineering Graduation Project in HV/MV Protection Department, Renewables Division, Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Are you approaching the end of your studies and looking for a graduation project early 2027. Does deep dive into the protection of the primary equipment enabling transport of wind energy to shore excite you? Then we have the project for you.

The projects

Protection study

Today we apply state of the art, cutting edge protections of the primary equipment, 220/66kV transformers, shunt reactors, subsea cables etc. Functions like line differential protection, restricted earth fault protection, distance protection with fiber optic accelerations schemes and different mechanical protections.

But how well do the different protections cover the primary equipment?

Are all protections feasible, considering how often we statistically experience faults?

Grounding

Today the MV grid, connecting the wind turbines to the Offshore Sub Station is impedance grounded. This creates different problems and side effects that needs to be considered during engineering. Some primary equipment becomes expensive and hard to procure. Protection against earth faults becomes challenging because of the reduced fault current.

Investigate the benefits and disadvantages of isolated, impedance and effectively grounded MV grid.

How will the protections need to be set up?

What will the implications be on primary equipment, transformers, cables, wind turbines etc.

Your Profile & Qualifications

We image that you are studying to become an Electrical Engineer. As a person you are ambitious and result oriented. You have an analytical mindset and strive to find solutions for complex problems and at the same time you enjoy collaborating within a team. Furthermore, you have a strong interest in learning and taking on challenges.

To succeed in this position, we expect that you have the following qualifications:

• Interest in electrical systems.

• Focus on digitalization and innovation.

• Can communicate in English, both written and verbal.

• Flexible, committed, loyal and dedicated.

• Great communication skills.

Welcome to Semco Maritime

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.

Care to join the movement?

Change. With us.

We conduct our interviews on an ongoing basis, so if you are interested, you must submit your application as soon as possible.

If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact Søren Borre Kreipke, Manager, HV Protection & Secondary at SOBK@semcomaritime.com

Building keeps getting cheaper every quarter. What used to take a senior engineer a few weeks now takes an afternoon. The work that does not get cheaper is helping a real business absorb new technology, sequencing the rollout, and knowing when to slow down because something is starting to break under load.

At Heyra, we build operational AI: systems, workflows, and data platforms that live in production from day one. We work with companies that are moving quickly and need solutions that improve the way they operate.

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer. Someone who goes into a client, understands the operation, spots where the real optimisation potential sits, and pushes it all the way through to execution with a strong engineering team behind them.

The role sits between engineering and consulting without fitting cleanly into either. You need to be technical enough to understand data and AI at a deep level. Commercial enough to spot where the business value sits. Patient enough to sit with a manager who is genuinely worried about the tool you just put in front of them. And stubborn enough to stay around once the launch excitement fades and the real adoption work begins.

Most people are strong in one of those. Some in two. Almost nobody walks in with all four. That is exactly the profile we are looking for.

What you will work on

You will embed directly with clients to understand the operation and where the real value sits. You will drive adoption by sequencing rollouts, working with the people who have to use the tool, and staying through the unglamorous part. You will translate business needs into AI solutions that actually ship. And you will learn when to push, when to slow down, and when something is starting to break under load.

You work closely with engineers, data specialists, strategists, and designers in a company where the distance from thinking to building is intentionally small.

**Requirements

**Experience with management consulting, change management, or adoption of AI solutions in production. An understanding of software development, ML or data engineering. Familiarity with AI and GenAI frameworks, possibly with some MLOps and evals exposure. Experience with cloud environments like Azure or GCP.

Coding with agents like Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. Working directly with clients and stakeholders. Owning delivery end to end, from a vague problem to a live, adopted solution.

Curiosity, taste and a builder mentality matter just as much to us as specific tools or years of experience.

Why Heyra

We believe consulting needs to be rewritten. We are building a consultancy designed for the agentic era. We design, build and operate AI products that change how enterprises work, from problem to prototype to production.

Heyra brings together people from engineering, strategy, product, startup and creative environments. We keep teams small, collaboration close and momentum high. We care deeply about craft, speed and building things that work in the real world.

People here care about what they build. Good ideas move quickly. New technology gets explored early. There is room to shape both the company and the way we work.

We are around 45 people today, and we are only just getting started.

If this sounds like your kind of work, send us a short note about yourself together with your CV. We care much more about curiosity, energy and the way you think than polished applications.

**Benefits

**

• Healthcare insurance

• Pension plan

• Parental leave

• Social gatherings

• New tech gear

• Central office

• Free lunch, coffee, snacks, and Friday beers

• Skill development

• Paid holiday

• Remote work allowed

• Pet friendly

Would you like to set the technical direction for Denmark's national, digitally sovereign supercomputing and cloud platform? DTU Computerome is looking for a Chief Technology Officer to lead the architecture, engineering and long-term technology strategy of a platform used by researchers, public institutions and industry across Denmark. 

About DTU Computerome 
DTU Computerome is a national High-Performance Computing (HPC) and secure cloud platform designed to support sensitive data processing and the hosting of advanced applications and services. 

The platform is developed and operated as a fully digitally sovereign infrastructure. Critical research workloads, sensitive data, and digital services for the public sector and Danish industry are hosted within a trusted, nationally controlled environment. 

Computerome functions as a general infrastructure and service provider, offering: 

• High-performance computing resources for complex workloads 
• Secure environments for processing sensitive and regulated data 
• Infrastructure for hosting research platforms, digital services and scientific applications 
• Flexible environments for innovation, experimentation and development of new digital solutions 
Users include research groups from all Danish universities, international research collaborations, public authorities and industry partners. Many rely on Computerome as a stable platform for long-running services, data platforms and research applications. 

The infrastructure includes a large-scale Linux-based HPC cluster, a 50 PB high-performance storage system, a custom-built secure cloud environment, and platforms for containerized applications, research services and data workflows. Computerome is physically located at DTU Risø, while the operations and development team is based at DTU Lyngby. 

The Job 
As CTO, you will own Computerome's technology strategy and platform architecture, and lead the engineering and DevOps organisation that operates and develops it. You will be part of Computerome's management team and work closely with the Director and COO on strategy, investments and partnerships. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

• Defining and owning the technology strategy and multi-year roadmap for the HPC, storage, network and cloud platform 
• Leading, developing and recruiting the DevOps and platform engineering teams, including the five new DevOps engineers currently being hired 
• Owning the overall platform architecture and making key design decisions across compute, storage, networking and cloud 
• Ensuring stable, secure and scalable operation, including incident management, on-call structure and service levels 
• Driving automation, Infrastructure-as-Code and modern DevOps practices across the organisation 
• Leading technical evaluation, requirement specification and vendor selection in procurements and tenders 
• Planning capacity, lifecycle and hardware refresh, and owning the technical side of investment cases and budgets 
• Representing Computerome technically towards users, partners, authorities and national and European infrastructure initiatives 
Strategic Focus Areas 
Computerome is growing from a research HPC facility into a broader national provider of sovereign compute, data and cloud services. As CTO you will shape how the platform meets that ambition. Key areas include: 

• Digital sovereignty: Designing an architecture built on open, European-controllable technologies that reduces dependence on non-European hyperscalers, and ensuring data portability and national control over critical workloads 
• AI and GPU infrastructure: Expanding capacity and services for AI, large-scale analytics and GPU-intensive research 
• Secure and regulated environments: Strengthening platforms for sensitive personal and health data, in line with GDPR, NIS2, ISO and relevant security standards 
• Cloud and platform services: Evolving the secure cloud, container and Kubernetes offerings so that public institutions and industry can host long-running services and products 
• Scalability and new capacity: Contributing technically to new datacenter capacity, energy efficiency and long-term infrastructure planning 
• Operational excellence: Building monitoring, observability, service management and processes that match the expectations of critical national infrastructure 
Your Profile 
We are looking for an experienced technology leader who combines deep infrastructure expertise with strategic overview and the ability to build strong teams. 

Required qualifications 

• A master's degree in computer science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience 
• At least 10 years of experience with large-scale IT infrastructure, of which several years in a technical leadership role 
• Proven experience leading engineering, DevOps or operations teams, including people management and recruitment 
• Deep knowledge of Linux-based infrastructure, virtualization and cloud platforms (e.g. OpenStack, Kubernetes) 
• Solid understanding of storage, networking and IT security architecture 
• Experience with automation, Infrastructure-as-Code and modern DevOps practices 
• Experience with technical procurement, vendor management and budget responsibility 
• Ability to translate technology into strategy and communicate clearly with management, users and partners 
• Fluency in English; Danish is an advantage 
It is an advantage if you also have experience with 

• HPC environments, job scheduling and parallel file systems (e.g. IBM Storage Scale) 
• AI workloads and GPU infrastructure at scale 
• Sensitive data environments and compliance (GDPR, NIS2, ISO 27001) 
• Public sector procurement, EU tenders or research infrastructure 
• European cloud and sovereignty initiatives 
• Datacenter design, power and cooling 
What We Offer 
We offer a key leadership role with real influence on how a national, digitally sovereign computing platform evolves. You will lead skilled colleagues in an international research environment where advanced infrastructure directly enables scientific discovery and digital innovation. 

At DTU we emphasize: 

• A high level of technical professionalism 
• Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development 
• The possibility to shape national digital infrastructure 
• A collaborative environment with highly skilled colleagues 
Salary and Appointment Terms 
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). You are employed as an Academic Officer, Senior Officer, Senior Executive Officer. In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for academic staff employed in technical-administrative positions at DTU (AC TAP): https://www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures 

The position is full-time and based at DTU Lyngby with regular presence at DTU Risø.

Application and Contact

If you would like additional information about the position, please contact Mads Bager Hoffmann on mabho@dtu.dk

Does it excite you to work with shaping the equity story of a peptide-based biotech company and strengthening relationships with investors and analysts across Europe, and do you have experience with investor relations and corporate communications in biotech or pharma? If this sounds like you, and you are ready to take on a broad area of responsibilities, then you could be our new colleague.

Your new position

As Director of Investor Relations, you will be a key voice of the company towards the global investment community, working closely with the Vice President, Head of Investor Relations. A central focus of the position is to enhance and grow relationships with analysts and investors in Europe. You will translate complex science, clinical progress, and strategy into a clear and credible narrative for shareholders, prospective investors, analysts, and the broader financial community. The position combines strategic communication, close collaboration with senior leadership, and direct exposure to the capital markets at an exciting stage of the company’s development.

We offer exciting responsibilities:

• 
Strengthen and expand relationships with European institutional investors, sell-side analysts, and other capital market stakeholders, serving as a primary point of contact for investor inquiries

• 
Support the development and execution of the investor relations strategy and equity story in close alignment with the Head of Investor Relations, senior leadership, and the company’s financial and strategic goals

• 
Work together with IR Coordinator to plan and lead European roadshows, investor meetings, conferences, and capital markets events, as well as quarterly earnings communications

• 
Prepare financial results communications, earnings releases, investor presentations, scripts, Q&A materials, and annual and interim report content

• 
Monitor and analyze market trends, competitive intelligence, investor sentiment, and shareholder composition, particularly in Europe, and provide insights and recommendations to leadership

• 
Contribute to corporate communications, including press releases, media relations, and social media content, and safeguard consistent corporate messaging across channels, while ensuring compliance with applicable disclosure and market regulations in collaboration with Legal, Finance, and Corporate Communications

Your profile

You are a credible and confident communicator who builds trust easily with both scientific and financial audiences. You are strategic and analytical, with strong financial acumen and sound judgment when handling sensitive and market-moving information. You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple projects at pace. You are a natural collaborator who works effectively across functions.

• 
Significant experience in investor relations, corporate communications, equity research, investment banking, or a related capital markets role, within biotech, pharma, or healthcare

• 
Strong understanding of drug development, clinical data, and biotech valuation drivers, as well as in-depth knowledge of financial markets and listed-company disclosure and reporting requirements

• 
Proven track record of building and maintaining relationships with institutional investors, sell-side analysts, and the media, ideally with an established network in the European investment community

• 
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret financial data and industry trends

• 
Ability to collaborate across functions and influence stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership, combined with excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

• 
University degree in finance, economics, communications, business, life sciences, or a related field; an MBA is a plus

Your new team

The position reports to the Vice President, Head of Investor Relations, and is part of the Investor Relations team that reports to the CFO. The team includes an Investor Relation coordinator and we work very closely with Corporate Communications.

Let’s bond and be bold

We have a unique culture, characterized by excellent teamwork and strong engagement across the organization. And we want you to help us strengthen this culture.

Making bonds is at the core of everything we do. From discovering and developing the best new drugs for metabolic health for patients, to engaging with our partners or connecting with each other. We bond through curiosity and playfulness as a team, allowing ourselves to challenge common thinking and drive future innovation. Join us and let’s bond and be bold.

Interested in bonding with us? Then please apply no later than 12 November 2026, or as soon as possible. The applications will be reviewed as they come in. While a cover letter is not required, please include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.

For further information, please contact Vice President, Head of Investor Relations Eric Rojas at erojas@zealandpharma.com.

We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and welcome applications from all job applicants.

About Zealand Pharma A/S

Zealand Pharma A/S (Nasdaq: ZEAL) is a biotechnology company focused on advancing medicines for obesity and metabolic health. Combining more than 25 years of peptide R&D expertise with a proprietary data platform that leverages advanced data-driven and AI/ML approaches, Zealand Pharma aims to lead a new era in obesity and metabolic health. To date, more than ten Zealand Pharma-invented drug candidates have entered clinical development, of which two products have reached the market and three candidates are in late-stage development. The Company has collaborations with global pharmaceutical and biotechnology partners for research, development, and commercialization. Founded in 1998, Zealand Pharma is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, with a U.S. presence in Boston, Massachusetts. Learn more at www.zealandpharma.com.

Do you want to build the operational backbone behind a new way of monetizing software - where pricing, product usage, data, and billing all need to connect seamlessly?

Trackunit is changing how we charge customers as we move from a traditional SaaS model towards more flexible, usage-based offerings. That means we need to connect a lot of moving parts: what customers use, how that usage is measured, what they have agreed to pay for, and what ultimately appears on their invoice.

As our Senior Monetization Operations Manager, you’ll help us make that entire flow work. You’ll build the processes and checks that help us catch errors early, keep our systems aligned, and give both customers and colleagues confidence that our billing is accurate.

This is a senior individual contributor role with a lot of ownership, but no formal people-management responsibility. You’ll work closely with colleagues across Product, Engineering, Data, Finance, Revenue & Billing and RevOps. Some of the foundations are still being built, so you won’t simply inherit a finished setup. You’ll have an important role in shaping how we work—and we hope that’s the kind of challenge you find energizing.

Trackunit is a fast-growing company and a leading supplier of IoT solutions, operating out of many offices worldwide. We create digital solutions that connect machines, people, and systems in the global construction industry, helping one of the world’s least digitalized industries become more connected, efficient, and productive.

With locations in Denmark, Germany and the Netherlands, we offer a flexible setup giving you the option to work from our hubs or remotely in these countries.

**What’s in it for you?

**

• A place in an agile growth SaaS business, with possibilities to grow internally in the company. We are moving quickly, so fasten your seat belt and prepare to adjust. Back in 2020 we were 150 employees at Trackunit and we have just passed 450 employees.

• International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.

• We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and support them through training, coaching and mindfulness, alongside an open feedback culture that helps you identify your strengths and opportunities. We do this by focusing on your impact on yourself, your team, and the organization.

• Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us. We believe you know how you work best. Once you've decided what works for you, we'll make sure you have the IT equipment and support you need.

• Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. This priority starts with our hiring - we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We assess candidates solely on their qualifications and merit.

**Who are you ideally?

**We’re looking for a hands-on monetization operations expert who combines strong systems and data fluency with the ability to create structure across a complex, cross-functional environment.

**Ideally, You Bring

**

• Experience running or improving usage-based monetization operations, consumption platforms, metering, rating, or another environment where customer usage needs to be captured and processed accurately.

• The ability to follow data through several systems, spot when something doesn’t add up, and work out where the problem started - not just fix the final output.

• Experience setting up and testing products, price plans, usage rules, or similar configurations before they are released.

• A practical approach to processes and controls. You know how to make an operation reliable without creating unnecessary complexity or slowing everyone down.

• The confidence to bring Product, Engineering, Data, Finance, and commercial teams together when an issue crosses several areas - and to keep the work moving until the underlying cause has been resolved.

• Comfort working closely with both technical and commercial colleagues. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should be curious about how data and systems work and willing to get into the details.

• The judgment to spot risks, challenge unclear ownership, and set clear standards, even when you don’t formally manage the people involved.

• Experience with usage-metering or monetization platforms such as m3ter, Metronome, Amberflo, or similar would be a strong advantage. Familiarity with Salesforce, NetSuite, Databricks, or related systems would also be valuable, but we don’t expect you to know our exact technology stack from day one.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries - this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're excited about this opportunity and your experience doesn't perfectly match every qualification, we'd still love to hear from you.

**Primary Responsibilities

****In this role, you will:

**

• Build and improve the way we run monetization operations, including clear processes, responsibilities, checks, and ways to escalate issues.

• Make sure new products and pricing plans are set up, tested, approved, and released correctly in m3ter and our connected systems.

• Keep track of whether the full flow from customer usage to invoice is working as expected and make risks or gaps visible early.

• Put the right checks in place to identify missing, incorrect, or unusual data before it affects customer billing.

• Work with Finance and Revenue & Billing to make sure the data and documentation needed for invoicing, reconciliation, and audits are ready and reliable.

• Help turn agreed business and pricing rules into system configurations and practical ways of working.

• Lead investigations when usage, system configuration, or billing numbers don’t look right, bringing the relevant teams together to find and fix the underlying cause.

• Work with Product, Engineering, and Data to improve how usage is captured, moved between systems, and monitored.

• Create and maintain useful dashboards, instructions, control records, and documentation so people know what is happening and what to do when something goes wrong.

• Look for recurring problems and manual work that can be simplified or automated as the business grows.

• Help the Monetization Operations Specialist prioritize the right work and provide guidance on more complex issues, while working together as peers in the Monetization team.

**Our hiring process

**Don't waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that's not in the cover letter.

• Initial Interview conversation through zoom with a colleague from our People & Talent team to get to know each other better.

• Virtual meet and greet with the hiring manager and someone from the team.

• Assignment-specific interview. You'll receive a case study to prepare in advance and present to colleagues you'll work closely with in the role.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We're excited to welcome you to Trackunit!

**The question is: Are you in?

**
